title: Blind D13-class same-partition CoRichards qualification
question: On the exact C4R blind fixed-water-table workload, which conventional Richards discretisations using the frozen LARE R3-R12 partitions are numerically admissible under the same preregistered current-canonical D13 mode-5 Reference policy?

terminology.CoRichards: Conventional current-canonical Reference-Richards route executed on exactly the same fixed partition and spatial state count as the corresponding frozen LARE R_N member.

workload.bottom_boundary: mode 5 zero pressure head at fixed 160-cm lower boundary

partitions.role: C4R exact-reproduction control, not same-partition LARE ladder member

full_ladder_rule: R3,R4,R5,R6,R8,R12 are all attempted. No dimension is selected from C4R fidelity results.

preregistered_research_harness_changes.change: Generalize D13 numnod guard from [2,16] to [2,3,4,5,6,8,12,16].
preregistered_research_harness_changes.effect: Execution plumbing only; no solver/physics/numerical-policy change.

preregistered_research_harness_changes.change: Use the already-bound C4R labels/lambdas V01..V04.
Environment variable C4S_HISTORY_FILTER runs one fresh D13 history at a time; unset executes all four exactly as C4R.
preregistered_research_harness_changes.effect: Allows per-history fail-closed qualification without changing history physics.

preregistered_research_harness_changes.change: For nonuniform partitions, upper/lower output diagnostics use exact geometric overlap with 0-80 and 80-160 cm. R2/R16 retain original index-half expression to preserve byte-reproduction controls.
preregistered_research_harness_changes.effect: Diagnostic semantics only; not a qualification gate beyond finite output.

per_history_status.QUALIFIED: O0 and O2 both finish the selected history with exactly 64 committed states, hard transaction mass residual <=1e-12 cm, completion marker present, and byte-identical scientific stdout.
per_history_status.FAIL_CLOSED_REFERENCE_POLICY: O0 and O2 both fail under the frozen D13 policy with the same first F_ROMV2_D13_REF_FAIL marker before publishing completion.
per_history_status.TECHNICAL_FAILURE: Build, source/provenance, status identity, trace identity, or harness failure not classifiable as the frozen Reference policy.

outputs: status for every R3-R12 member and every V01-V04 history
maximum transaction mass residual for qualified histories
minimum reduced dimension with any qualified history
minimum reduced dimension with all four histories qualified

decisions.C4S_CORICHARDS_FULL_COMMON_COHORT_AVAILA: Hard gates pass and at least one R3-R12 member qualifies all four blind histories.
decisions.C4S_CORICHARDS_PARTIAL_COMMON_COHORT_ONL: Hard gates pass, no R3-R12 member qualifies all four, and at least one qualifies one or more histories.
decisions.C4S_CORICHARDS_REDUCED_COMPARATOR_UNAVAI: Hard gates pass and no R3-R12 member qualifies any blind history.

successor.if_full: A separately preregistered cost-fidelity screen may use members/histories from the full common cohort, with C4R fidelity metrics frozen and runtime measured prospectively.
successor.if_partial: Any later value screen must be explicitly restricted to the preregistered common qualified histories and must report coverage loss as part of value; no extrapolation to all C4R histories.
successor.if_unavailable: No same-partition CoRichards value comparator exists under current authority. Do not relax time step/tolerances/fallback after result.
